title: VISASQ/COLEMAN Launches AI Scout, Offering Clients Expert Matches in Under Five Minutes
summary: VISASQ/COLEMAN launched AI Scout, a service that gives clients direct, 24/7 access to the AI matching engine previously used only by its internal operations teams. The system aims to return qualified expert profiles within five minutes of a request submitted by email, with no login portal or forms. The company says it trained the technology for two years using a human-in-the-loop method across thousands of project scopes, and that its network includes more than 770,000 experts.
whyItMatters: Opening an internal matching engine directly to clients compresses the first step of an expert project from hours to minutes and reduces dependence on associate-driven sourcing.
